What a branch property decision can hide about carbon

The energy bill is visible. Materials, construction, refurbishment and end-of-life impacts are harder to see, but they still shape the decision.

By Pupsi Phull3 minute read

Evidence boundary. Published metrics retain their stated source and context. Diagrams are illustrative and contain no client data.

A metric that can mislead

Operational energy is measurable and familiar, so it can dominate a property decision. That does not make it the whole carbon story.

What the evidence suggests

Set the assessment boundary before comparing options. Record what is measured, what is estimated and where the range of uncertainty is widest.

Before you change the network

Ask whether the decision changes only the energy profile, or also creates material, construction, refurbishment and end-of-life impacts elsewhere.
